title: Settle rejected delegation promotion before opening declared-run source capture
outcome: A rejected and still-current delegation queue promotion parks the unsent result before declared-run source capture, preserving Stop callback deferral and the existing runtime and promotion ownership fences.
acceptance: A rejected promotion with applicable declared-run configuration parks the same unsent result without starting source capture.
The successful handoff path, stale or superseded ownership, and Stop deferral retain their current behavior, with focused behavioral evidence.
